detail.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && echo '--- usages ---' && git grep -nE "pendulum|sliding-wall|'door'" -- src | grep -v 'src/obstacles/rotating.ts' | head -40 && echo '--- game dir ---' && ls src/game && echo '--- HoleRuntime refs ---' && git grep -ln 'HoleRuntime' -- src && echo '--- test files ---' && ls src/game/*.test.ts src/**/*.test.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40
